37: ### 7. Frameless Status Bars (Below the Joy Blob)
38: - **Below the Pet Layout**: Positioned the health (â¤ï¸) and energy (âš¡) progress bars directly below the Joy Blob (`bottom: 8px`).
39: - **Frameless Minimalist Style**: Removed the background container box, borders, shadows, and paddings from `.pet-floating-hud` so it renders as two clean, borderless progress lines.
40: - **Enhanced Readability**: Added `text-shadow: 1px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)` to the progress labels so they are clearly legible against all the colorful room background graphics.
41: - **Independent Layout Rotation**: Wrapped the Joy Blob SVG inside a `.pet-svg-container`. When sleeping, only this inner container rotates `-90deg` to lay horizontally, while the parent wrapper stays upright, allowing the floating status HUD to remain perfectly horizontal and readable!
42: - **State Synchronization**: Tied the HUD values and progress fills directly to the main state logic, automatically updating whenever Joy Blob eats, sleeps, bathes, or plays minigames.

44: ### 8. Actual Sleeping Pose (Horizontal + Closed Eyes)
45: - **Closed Eyes Expression**: Created a closed eyelids group (`#sleepingEyesGroup`) using curved SVG arcs in `index.html`. When sleeping, the script toggles off the normal eyes/mouth and displays the closed eyes.
46: - **Horizontal Pose**: Added CSS rules so that when the sleep state is triggered (`pos-bed.sleeping`), Joy Blob's wrapper is rotated `-90deg` and repositioned to lay horizontally on the mattress, resting its head right on the pillow.
47: - **Bed Alignment Adjustments**: Aligned sleeping positions to `bottom: 12%` and `left: -4%` to compensate for rotation offset and center Joy Blob cleanly on the generated bed sheet.

51: - **CSS Clip-path**: Applied `clip-path: inset(0% 0% 22% 0%)` on the `#mainJoyBlob` SVG when bathing. This cleanly cuts off the lower 22% of the blob body (including the floor shadow), making it look realistically submerged inside the bubble bath drawn in the background image.

53: ### 10. Floor Shadow Removal
54: - **Removed Floor Shadow**: Deleted the static SVG `<ellipse>` floor shadow from `index.html` to prevent any awkward flat black shadows from rendering in mid-air when Joy Blob is lying down on the bed or submerged in the bathtub.

When the app loads, if a device has an old cached state (e.g. from testing earlier or old sessions), the script automatically detects the mismatch, wipes the old local storage, and loads the fresh starting stats (Level 0, Coins 0, Food 0) without requiring any manual clicks!
